## Without the filter

A fragment on the text leaves the bullet behind, so the markers appear at once.

- [First item.]{.fragment fragment-index="1"}
- [Second item.]{.fragment fragment-index="2"}

## With the filter

An empty marker span at the start of the item is hoisted onto the item itself.

- []{.fragment fragment-index="1"} First item.
- []{.fragment fragment-index="2"} Second item.
- A plain item, with no fragment.

## Definitions and quotes

Spectroscopy
: []{.fragment fragment-index="1"} Revealed with its term.

> []{.fragment fragment-index="2"} The whole quote reveals as one.

## More

Every RevealJS fragment class travels with the marker, and `list-table` cells work too when that filter runs first.

Full documentation: <https://m.canouil.dev/quarto-revealjs-fragmention/>.
